module_summary: AXI-stream FIFO: packs stream fields into a RAM addressed by Gray-free binary write/commit/read pointers, reads through a RAM output pipeline, with optional frame drop/mark modes and depth status.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO RAM storing packed stream words, written at wr_ptr, read at rd_ptr.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Write pointer addressing mem; increments per accepted beat, rewinds on dropped frames.

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Read pointer addressing mem; increments when data moved into output pipeline.

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer visible to reader; defines empty and frame rollback point.

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: FIFO full from pointer MSB compare; deasserts s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: FIFO empty (commit ptr == rd ptr); blocks reads into pipeline.

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: Frame larger than FIFO detect; frame-FIFO mode only.

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Currently dropping frame flag (frame/mark modes, disabled by default).

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: Marking frame bad when full; forces tlast/tuser (MARK_WHEN_FULL only).

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: Oversize frame being passed through in frame mode.

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: Input in-frame tracker used when marking frames.

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying words from mem to output.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: Valid bits of read pipeline stages; bubble detection for advancing.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: Ready into read pipeline from output stage.

anchors.name: s_axis
anchors.why: Packed input word (data, last, user, mark) written into mem.

anchors.name: m_axis
anchors.why: Packed word from last pipeline stage, unpacked to output fields.

anchors.name: depth_reg
anchors.why: Registered occupancy wr_ptr - rd_ptr driving status_depth.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Pulse when a frame was dropped/overflowed.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload packed into the FIFO word.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; with ready writes mem and advances wr_ptr.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready, low when full (unless drop/mark modes).

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload unpacked from the read pipeline.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from last pipeline stage (gated by pause if enabled).

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready advancing the read pipeline.

groups.name: Write control
groups.description: Write/commit pointers, full detection and frame drop/mark logic.

groups.name: Read pipeline
groups.description: Read pointer, empty and RAM output pipeline to m_axis.
